scope: Three FLUX.1 Kontext Dev local qualifier points only: BUS_01, BUS_06 and BUS_09. No PuLID, LoRA, postprocess, reroll, external model, QA/ranking, or Production Pilot action.

identity.method: FLUX.1 Kontext Dev native single-primary-reference image-conditioning workflow
identity.limitation: The reused working Kontext graph has one connected primary identity input. REF01 is the frontal canonical reference; REF02 and REF03 are not connected because no existing P01 multi-reference Kontext graph was found.

generation.resolution_policy: The existing Kontext workflow uses FluxKontextImageScale on the primary reference and reuses that latent for sampling. The native scale selects its preferred closest vertical size; actual output dimensions are recorded rather than resized afterward.
generation.reference_latent_method: model default (offset); no FluxKontextMultiReferenceLatentMethod override in the reused graph

prompt_policy: Use each existing canonical resolved SceneSpec verbatim inside the same neutral Kontext instruction: 'Place the same adult man in this scene: {SceneSpec} Preserve his facial features, apparent age, bald head, natural skin texture, identity, and photorealistic quality. Do not add other people.'
